common.identifierHint: For example name@hakoremfarms.com, or a phone number starting with +233.
common.newPasswordHint: At least 12 characters. It is checked against passwords known to be breached.

totp.title: Enter your code
totp.body: Open your authenticator app and enter the six-digit code. A recovery code also works.
totp.codeHint: Six digits, or a recovery code.

change.title: Choose a new password
change.body: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own before you continue.
change.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter the email or phone number on your account. If it exists, a reset code is sent.
forgot.sentBody: If the account exists, a reset code has been sent.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.body: Enter the code you were sent, then choose a new password.
reset.doneBody: You can sign in with your new password.

expired.title: Your session ended
expired.body: For your safety you were signed out. Sign in again to carry on.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email, phone number or password is not right.
errors.TOTP_INVALID: That code is wrong or has already been used.
errors.CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: That sign-in took too long. Start again.
errors.PASSWORD_BREACHED: That password appears in a list of breached passwords. Choose a different one.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the fields below and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.NETWORK: We could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
